en.quote: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond-tree. Then said the LORD unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.
en.riddle: I see a rod of an almond-tree.
en.speaker: the LORD

he.quote: וַיְהִי דְבַר-יְהוָה אֵלַי לֵאמֹר מָה-אַתָּה רֹאֶה יִרְמְיָהוּ וָאֹמַר מַקֵּל שָׁקֵד אֲנִי רֹאֶה וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלַי הֵיטַבְתָּ לִרְאוֹת כִּֽי-שֹׁקֵד אֲנִי עַל-דְּבָרִי לַעֲשֹׂתֽוֹ
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי
